one_liner: Plans and coordinates public health emergency preparedness and response for the Virginia Department of Health's local health district covering Fauquier County.
fit_summary: One of the closest fits on the board. Daniel's resume covers the core of a local health emergency coordinator: COVID-19 mass vaccination and monoclonal antibody site logistics, mpox response meetings for a state health agency, tabletop and FEMA full-scale exercises (he led a Simulation Cell unit), healthcare preparedness conferences, and IS-100, 120, 700 and 800. The posting text was unavailable, so confirm the minimum qualifications and any on-call duty.
eligibility: The posting text was unavailable, so open the full listing on jobs.virginia.gov and confirm the minimum qualifications, any preferred education such as a degree in emergency management or public health, and any required certifications.
Check which FEMA or VDEM training is expected. He has IS-100, 700 and 800 and the Professional Development Series; IS-200 is the usual missing piece, so finish it before applying.
Confirm whether a valid driver's license, a background check, or after-hours on-call availability is a condition of employment.
Virginia state jobs are generally open to the public, so no federal status or veterans' preference is needed, but verify that no special restrictions apply.
strategy: Pull the full posting and use its knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSA) terms wherever they truthfully describe his work. Virginia's PeopleAdmin screeners score against the posted qualifications.

Frame the IEM experience concretely: vaccination and monoclonal antibody site logistics in Texas, Nevada, Virginia and Florida, mpox response meetings for a state health agency, tabletop and FEMA full-scale exercises, and FEMA Public Assistance onboarding data.

Lead with partner coordination he can document: facilitating exercises for federal, state and private-sector clients, helping counties update COVID-19 emergency grant applications, taking minutes at a state health agency's weekly mpox response meetings, and setting up medical supply and truck rental vendor relationships for COVID-19 sites.
List his FEMA courses by number (IS-100, 120, 700, 800, 2500, 2600 and the Professional Development Series), and finish IS-200 online before applying; it is free and often expected.

Fill out every field of the state application fully rather than writing "see resume," because Virginia HR screens the application itself. Apply well before the November 13, 2026 close, since state postings can close early.
Emphasize that you live in Manassas, close to Fauquier, which supports your availability for local response.
resume_bullets: Oversaw logistics for COVID-19 mass vaccination and monoclonal antibody sites in Texas, Nevada, Virginia and Florida at the same time (2021–2022), procuring and tracking medical supplies across six states.

Facilitated full-scale and tabletop exercises for federal, state and private-sector clients (2022–2024), and led a Simulation Cell unit at FEMA full-scale exercises two years in a row, delivering notes used for the after-action reports.

Helped stand up new COVID-19 mass care sites as on-site assistant to project managers (2021–2022), and took minutes at a state public health agency's weekly meetings during the mpox response (Dec 2022 – Mar 2023).
